item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00156","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C23","C04","C01"],"selected_candidate_label":"C23","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C23 is a highly plausible direct drafting template. Both directives address plural disputes involving a lead railroad and a large attached list of other carriers, use nearly identical Railway Labor Act and National Mediation Board recitals, require a presidential report within thirty days, and impose the same section 10 status-quo period on all involved carriers and employees. Their attached carrier lists also overlap extensively and follow substantially the same regional body of railroads. C04 supplies the same standard emergency-board language but lacks the distinctive multi-carrier/list structure.
